title: Init Cost
statement: Implement `solve(graph, start)`. `graph` maps a module name to the list of modules it imports while loading. Return the names loaded, including `start`, in depth-first order, each name once. Cycles must not loop forever.
hints: Use an explicit stack or recursion with a seen set.
Append a name when you first enter it.
Skip names already seen so a cycle stops.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Importing a submodule executes the package __init__ and then the submodule, and each of those imports run once.

editorial: Importing a submodule executes the package __init__ and then the submodule, and each of those imports run once. A seen set is sys.modules in miniature. Depth-first order matches a loader that finishes a dependency before continuing the current module's next import, if you record the name before walking its edges.
